capabilities: Play podcast episodes sentence by sentence from a transcript
Loop a single sentence and change playback speed
Look up words and add them to a spaced-repetition list
Flag sentences into a mistake notebook and record shadowing audio
Save episodes as reading notes and track listening stats
extras: Desktop only; local Python is used for ASR and recording. Feeds, transcripts, stats, recordings and notes stay in the vault, with no telemetry or account; an optional external TTS sends requests to that service.
problem: Podcast audio in Obsidian is not tied to a transcript, so learners cannot replay one sentence, look up words, or track what they have studied.

requires.name: Python with faster-whisper (local ASR and recording)

summary: Sentence-by-sentence English podcast player with transcripts, loop playback, word lookup, shadowing, spaced repetition and study stats.
